originality.rationale: General finite Gabor nonvanishing and Weyl criteria are prior work. The new claim is the explicit complete three-stratum rank discriminant for all complex superposition parameters, including a constructive unimodular full-rank family at every odd prime. Statement-level comparisons to Bartusel 2022 and several published rank discriminants did not identify equivalent or stronger coverage; residual older radar/waveform bibliography remains a risk.
